blocks.text: Exercise 2: (1) Draw a parallelogram and label it PQRS. (2) State two properties of its opposite sides. (3) A parallelogram has a base of 11 cm and perpendicular height of 7 cm. Find the area. (4) A parallelogram covers 96 cm² and has a base of 16 cm. Find its height. (5) A parallelogram has a sloping side of 10 cm, a base of 12 cm and a perpendicular height to that base of 8 cm. Find its area. (6) Explain why a sloping side cannot always replace perpendicular height.

Exercise 2 answers for teacher checking: Activity: parallelogram; AB parallel to DC; AD parallel to BC; base 6 units and height 4 units. Questions: (1) valid labelled parallelogram; (2) opposite sides parallel and equal; (3) 77 cm²; (4) 6 cm; (5) 96 cm²; (6) sloping length is not necessarily perpendicular to the base.
